scope: Small original raw final-DEB public COCO8 evaluation artifacts; six CPU/CUDA cases and three same-weight comparisons. Archiving performs no inference.

dataset_provenance.purpose: Public ground-truth data for inference pipeline integration, not representative football accuracy
dataset_provenance.configuration_changes: Set absolute QA dataset path and remove automatic download instruction; names and split unchanged
dataset_provenance.negative_target: COCO original class ID 32: sports ball; val has zero annotated instances

dataset_note: Four public COCO8 Val images verify pipeline integration, not football accuracy or deployment/generalization quality. No private dataset is included.

pt_torchscript_cpu.note: Same weights only; different YOLO architectures are not expected to have equal accuracy.

onnx_cpu_cuda.note: Same weights only; different YOLO architectures are not expected to have equal accuracy.

pt_cpu_cuda.note: Same weights only; different YOLO architectures are not expected to have equal accuracy.

limitations: This is preservation of existing final-package raw evidence, not another executed test suite.
Timing and tiny-set metrics are not advertised performance or model-quality guarantees.

visual_inspection.result: Reviewed actual CUDA analysis window: compact two-row top controls, readable metrics and visible curve; no overlay or clipping in the selected frame.
Reviewed actual PT CPU preview: source image, GT and predicted box, target list and compact top controls visible.
